workloadProfile.grouping: Platform network domain; conservative all-or-none required-job connectivity within each affected domain.
workloadProfile.direction: Simultaneous source-to-node direction only; no reverse-direction pooling. Cluster and external traffic share downstream resources.
workloadProfile.switching: One charge per traversed switch per traffic class; ingress plus egress is not counted twice.
workloadProfile.provenance: NEPTUNE synthetic reference assumptions; not measured training traffic or vendor validation.
workloadProfile.scope: Offered network demand and connectivity only. No packet, latency, training-speed or delivered-throughput prediction.

economics.exclusions: Land, shore/grid works, finance, permits, taxes, mooring, operations, replacement, proprietary hardware options. Illustrative assumptions; no vendor quotations.
